query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
The CNH US catalog does **not list one unique master brake cylinder** for a 1985 CASE W20C; it shows different brake-actuator configurations:

- **N8469** — hydraulic master cylinder, used with actuator figures 7-58 through 7-68; repair kit **N6937**.  
- **N9055** — master-cylinder air-chamber assembly, also shown in the earlier actuator configuration. [Assembly evidence: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]
- **N8695** — hydraulic master cylinder with **200 mm stroke**, contained in brake actuator **L113007**; repair kit **N8937**. [Assembly evidence: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

The catalog indicates that earlier actuators **L107985/L112959** are replaced by **L113007**, but the cylinder options should not be assumed interchangeable.

*US catalog evidence only; exact fitment depends on which brake actuator is installed. Do you know whether your machine has actuator L113007?

source_notes: Discovery uses a dated, partial local snapshot; no match does not establish CNH absence.
Supply a model with any known year, make, and variant. Similarity is not confirmed fitment.
